breakdown.description: Dittus–Boelter (turbulent) correlation is applied in the laminar regime (Re=800).
breakdown.reason: The agent did not resolve this inconsistency. While it added a note acknowledging the concern about applying Dittus-Boelter to laminar flow, it still explicitly instructs to use the Dittus-Boelter correlation (Nu = 0.023 * Re^0.8 * Pr^0.4). The ground truth requires switching to an appropriate laminar correlation such as Nu=3.66 for constant wall temperature. The agent repeated the original error by keeping the turbulent correlation as the primary calculation method.
